sn22.6:1.1: Tatra kho || voca || || Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā bhūtam pajānāti || || Kiñca yathābhūtam pajānāti || Rūpassa samudayañca atthagamañ ca || Vedanāya samudayañca atthagamañ ca || Saṅkhārānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañ ca || Yathā pathamasutte tathā vitthāretabbo || ||
